summary: Security Retest Iteration 102 - All 7 findings from iter 91 RESOLVED. Rating upgraded from B → A. New DSGVO UI in ProfilePage verified working. All regression tests passed.

FINDING_1_CORS.details: App-level CORS in server.py only allows FRONTEND_URL and localhost:3000. Ingress may add * but app is strict.

FINDING_2_PUSH_SUBSCRIBE_AUTH.details: POST /api/news/push/subscribe without token returns 401. With valid token returns 200/201.

FINDING_3_RESET_TOKEN_LOG.details: Password reset token is masked in logs. Only shows 'token tail only: …XXXXXX' on dispatch failure.
FINDING_3_RESET_TOKEN_LOG.evidence: auth.py line 326-330 logs only token[-6:] masked

FINDING_4_SECURITY_HEADERS.details: All 6 security headers present: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy: camera=(self)..., Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors 'none', Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
FINDING_4_SECURITY_HEADERS.evidence: curl -sI shows all headers present via middleware in server.py line 237-257

FINDING_5_LOGOUT_COOKIE_ATTRS.details: POST /api/auth/logout Set-Cookie headers have HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=none matching login.
FINDING_5_LOGOUT_COOKIE_ATTRS.evidence: Set-Cookie: access_token=""; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0; SameSite=none; Secure

FINDING_6_WEBSOCKET_JWT_VALIDATION.details: WS /api/ws/{mid}/{uid} validates JWT: (a) no token → 4401, (b) wrong user_id → 4403, (c) invalid token → 4401, (d) correct token → connects with peers msg

FINDING_7_DSGVO_ENDPOINTS.details: GET /api/users/me/export returns 200 with 21 keys. DELETE /api/users/me deletes user and invalidates cookies. Both require auth (401 without).
FINDING_7_DSGVO_ENDPOINTS.evidence: Export returns: profile, meetings_hosted, meeting_participations, chat_messages, news_posts_authored, etc. Delete test user verified gone.

All security headers present. WebSocket JWT validation working with proper close codes. No outstanding security issues.
security_rating_explanation: Rating A indicates excellent security posture. All previously identified issues have been resolved: (1) CORS restricted to FRONTEND_URL, (2) Push subscribe requires auth, (3) Reset tokens masked in logs, (4) All 6 security headers present, (5) Logout cookies match login attributes, (6) WebSocket validates JWT with proper close codes, (7) DSGVO export and delete endpoints implemented. No critical, high, or medium severity vulnerabilities remain.
